title: monday.com costs 10 people $1,080 a year. Claude built this instead #shorts
description:
Free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/project-status-board?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=short&utm_campaign=project-status-board

Claude built a weekly project status board, a monday.com alternative with one square per project per week, a "No update" flag when an owner misses a week and a report that assembles itself, from one written spec: all 28 acceptance checks passed, along with 64 automated tests. The test build also exposed 6 gaps in the spec, and every one is now fixed; production sign-in, real email delivery and hosting were not tested.

monday.com's Basic plan is $9 per seat per month billed yearly, so 10 people pay $1,080 a year; Standard is $12 and Pro $19, and portfolio project health is listed only on Enterprise (monday.com/pricing, checked November 2026).

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera intro and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.
